body.title: Trustworthy autonomous coding
body.problem: Evidence freshness, delegated authority, remembered deferrals, and live progress need one simpler workflow.
body.objective: Follow agent work through readable specs, explicit permission, meaningful progress, and current evidence.
body.appetite: Incremental delivery in independently verified verticals; portable local workflow first
outOfScope: Replacing existing W-005 work without reconciling scope
Multi-user SaaS, a new agent runtime, or generic workflow engine
Claiming full semantic equivalence between arbitrary prose and code
Rewriting historical facts or fabricating approvals

suggestedSlices.title: Every required check contributes to the verdict
acceptance: AC-05: Fail dominates missing, which dominates attested, which dominates pass; order never changes the result. Duplicate result keys are rejected. Empty ledgers show no requirements checked.

suggestedSlices.title: Reads cannot run checks or change ledger state
acceptance: AC-06: CLI execution and report persistence are explicit; client/server/context reads do not run commands, write reports, or resume automation.

suggestedSlices.title: Evidence and approvals match the current source
acceptance: AC-06/09: Relevant dirty and untracked content changes invalidate results and reviews; metadata-only changes and content-preserving commits do not. Artifact references are confined and integrity checked.

suggestedSlices.title: Proceed under explicit permission and scoped corrections
acceptance: AC-01/02: Revision approval, request and standing delegation are distinct; denial/revocation blocks affected work. Corrections are scoped, provenance is honest, context hashes content.

suggestedSlices.title: Deferred work returns when its feature is planned
acceptance: AC-03/04: Old unresolved linked deferrals appear independent of recent history; activation is persistent and idempotent, unknown inputs stay unknown, completion requires a valid response. Backlog projects drafts and deferrals.

suggestedSlices.title: Follow work through one clear session
acceptance: AC-07/08: CLI and read-only session projection show permission, acceptance/evidence, attention, meaningful changes, and preview. Polling reports disconnects; portable approval handoff is labeled honestly until a host bridge is selected.
